for r,c in np.argwhere((a!=0)&(a!=1)&(a!=8)):
 if len(bases):
  d=np.abs(bases-[r,c]).sum(1); i=d.argmin()
  if d[i]<=1: out[r,c]=a[tuple(bases[i])]
  else: out[r,c]=0
print(out.tolist())
